pages.observed: Five-frame sheet from 0.0 to 0.8 s of a vertical film. An airport curb scene with a phone showing a map route and Ride requested, an airport pickup sign, bench with teal suitcase, skyline, and a white generic car entering from the left edge. The scene is almost unchanged across frames. A caption box reading Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver, appears in the last two frames over the dark road area.

Five frames from 1.0 to 1.8 s. The white car with a roof sensor drives from the left edge into the pickup bay, moving rightward and settling in front of the bench and suitcase with a red brake light on. Phone, airport sign and skyline stay fixed. The caption Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver, stays on screen, now sitting higher on the dark road.

Five frames from 2.0 to 2.8 s. The white car comes to rest in the bay and a cream Texas outline card appears top right. By 2.4 s the picture changes to a driver-seat view with a steering wheel, rear-view mirror, dashboard map screen with a blue route, two empty gray seat backs, and the airport sign through the windshield. The phone card still floats at upper left and the same caption stays at lower area.

Five frames from 3.0 to 3.8 s inside the car. The steering wheel turns by itself with a tan marker moving around the rim, no person at the wheel. The airport sign slides right and out of the windshield suggesting the car pulls away. The Texas outline card at top right gets a black line drawn around its border. The dash map line shifts slightly. Phone card and the same caption remain unchanged.

Five frames 4.0 to 4.8 s. Four frames stay inside the car with empty seats and the same caption, the Texas outline card showing a drawn border. At 4.8 s the scene cuts to the curb: a larger tilted phone showing Ride requested overlaps the white car, airport sign and bench, Texas card now has a small orange dot, and no caption is shown on that frame.

Five frames 5.0 to 5.8 s at the curb. A large tilted phone partly covers the stopped white car. The phone status moves from Ride requested to Arriving At the curb, and the route dot advances on its map. The Texas card dot becomes a ring. Caption reads the airport included. Scene otherwise still.

Five frames 6.0 to 6.8 s. The curb scene holds with the phone saying Arriving At the curb and the pin sitting on the destination. Caption the airport included. is visible only in the first frame. At 6.8 s the view changes to a brown wooden table with a cream grid map, three small circular markers, a faint hatch patch, and a small calendar page labeled February. The Texas card with ring remains top right and no caption is shown.

Five frames 7.0 to 7.8 s. A static wooden table holds a cream gridded paper map with three small markers and a February calendar leaf. Caption reads The service began in February. From 7.6 s thin blue and tan lines are drawn on the map, and at 7.8 s the Texas card at top right fades. The label Illustration. Generic car with no brand mark still shows though no car is visible.

Five frames 8.0 to 8.8 s. The paper map on the wooden table fills in with a tan ring road, radiating roads and two blue wavy river lines crossing near the cluster of markers. The Texas card at top right fades away after the first frame. Calendar still reads February and the caption The service began in February stays. No vehicle is on screen.

Five frames 9.0 to 9.8 s. The camera moves closer to the paper map. A note card reading 60 square miles Limited area with a red pin lands at top, and a black line starts tracing a boundary on the map. The February calendar page slides off right then back in at lower left over the map edge. Caption changes to in a limited area of sixty square miles.

Five frames 10.0 to 10.8 s. A black line traces around the center of the map, enclosing the markers and the river, and by 10.8 s it closes into a roughly circular polygon filled with translucent gray. The 60 square miles note and the February calendar page sit still. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. stays.

Five nearly identical frames 11.0 to 11.8 s. The map holds still with the closed gray shaded polygon around the three markers and the river, the 60 square miles note at top right of it, and the February calendar lower left. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. stays throughout. Essentially a static hold.

Five frames 12.0 to 12.8 s. The first two still show the table map. At 12.4 s the picture cuts to an overhead view of a white car sitting in a brown creek with pale foam streaks and green banks and round trees. The label changes to Illustration. A different car, April 20th account. A caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. appears in the last frame.

Five frames 13.0 to 13.8 s. An overhead view of a white car with a roof sensor, seats visible and empty, sitting at a creek edge in brown water with foam streaks across it. Trees on green bank at lower right and left. Water texture shifts a little between frames while the car stays put. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. holds.

Five frames 14.0 to 14.8 s. The overhead creek scene continues. The white car, seats empty, shifts left and tilts a little through 14.6 s, then at 14.8 s the camera has moved so the car sits at lower right with the creek bend and new trees at upper left. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. remains.

Five frames 15.0 to 15.8 s. The overhead white car is carried by the current, rotating and drifting leftward and toward the left edge, with white wake strokes and a foam cluster trailing from its right end. Creek bank, trees and caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. stay. Clear continuous motion across the frames.

Five frames 16.0 to 16.8 s. The white car, foam trailing, slides out through the left edge, leaving only the empty brown creek with foam streaks, banks and trees in the last two frames. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. is on for three frames then removed.

Five frames 17.0 to 17.8 s. Two frames of the empty overhead creek, then a cut at 17.4 s to a side view of a white car with a roof sensor standing in brown floodwater on a street, with tan houses, a tree, green street signs behind and a paved walk in front. The label changes to Illustration. Another car, earlier in April. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. appears and holds. Scene is still.

Five frames 18.0 to 18.8 s. The white car drifts slowly to the right in the flood and its body sits lower in the water by the end, wheels more covered. Houses, tree and signs are fixed. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. holds on screen over the paved foreground.

Five frames 19.0 to 19.8 s. The white car sits low in brown floodwater, amber hazard lights flash at its ends in the middle frames, and at 19.8 s the camera pushes in so the car is much larger, the tree and houses are blurred behind it, and ripples show around its wheels. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. holds.

Five frames 20.0 to 20.8 s. Close view of the white car standing in brown water, empty windows, with amber front and red rear lights flashing alternately. Background tree, houses and signs are blurred. The car does not travel. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. holds throughout.

Five frames 21.0 to 21.8 s. The same close view of the stranded white car with blinking hazard lights over its reflection in brown water. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. shows in the first two frames and is gone in the last three. No other change in the picture.

Five frames 22.0 to 22.8 s. The first frame is the flood car with no caption. From 22.2 s the picture is a cream card on a wooden desk against olive green, titled Federal recall record and Vehicle safety recall, with ruled lines and a pen at right edge. The label returns to Illustration. Generic car with no brand mark. Caption Waymo filed a software recall appears at 22.6 s and a small cursor mark appears on the card at 22.8 s.

Five frames 23.0 to 23.8 s. The recall card settles on the desk and fills in line by line. First Recall type Software, then Potential units affected 3,791 typing in. The card straightens and shifts left a little. Caption Waymo filed a software recall holds throughout.

Five frames 24.0 to 24.8 s. The recall card is a static hold for four frames with caption Waymo filed a software recall. In the last frame the card moves higher and a grid of fifty dashed slots with about two small white cars and a faint third appears below it, a wooden block enters at the right, and the caption reads that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Five frames 25.0 to 25.8 s. Rows of tiny white car icons fill a 10 by 5 grid of dashed slots, nearly full by the end. A tan forearm with blue sleeve reaches in from the right pushing a wooden block over the recall card. The caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. holds.

Five frames 26.0 to 26.8 s. A forearm stamps the recall card, leaving an orange Software recall stamp mark by 26.6 s. A note card reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in below the card above a full grid of 50 white car icons. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. holds.

Five frames 27.0 to 27.8 s. The stamp arm slides out to the right, leaving the recall card with an orange Software recall stamp, the Nearly 3,800 vehicles note and the full 10 by 5 grid of white car icons. The caption is visible in three frames and gone in the last two. Almost no motion otherwise.

Five frames 28.0 to 28.8 s. The first is the desk with the stamped card and car grid. From 28.2 s a highway scene with skyline, lamp and trees shows a white car driving in from the left. The label reads Illustration. The recall wording, not a recorded event. A card quoting The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways fades in at upper left. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, appears from 28.4 s.

Five frames 29.0 to 29.8 s. A white car with a roof sensor holds mid-frame on a highway while the lane dashes and roadside lamp scroll past leftward. Thin water lines show at its wheels. A cream card quoting The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways stays at upper left. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, holds.

Five frames 30.0 to 30.8 s. The white car on the highway now has a red brake light on. A large gray puddle shape slides in from the right edge along the road toward it while the background scrolls. The quote card and caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, stay unchanged.

Five frames 31.0 to 31.8 s. The car keeps rolling at the same spot with a puddle sliding closer from the right. At 31.6 s the view pushes in to a large close side view of the white car, wheels spinning with a wavy water line below, seats empty. The recall quote card stays. Caption changes to then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Five frames 32.0 to 32.8 s. The enlarged white car sits in the same place while a gray puddle shape grows in from the right edge and reaches the front bumper area. Background grass scrolls. In the last frame the word may in the quote card is highlighted yellow. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. holds.

Five frames 33.0 to 33.8 s. The white car is shown large as the gray puddle spreads under it, the front wheel entering water with ripple rings and wake streaks by 33.8 s. The word may in the quote card is highlighted orange across all frames. A tree appears at the right edge. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. holds.

Five frames 34.0 to 34.8 s. The large white car moves through a gray puddle, with white splash droplets and wake lines at the front wheel and reflection beneath. A tree and then a lamp post slide in at the upper right. The quote card with may highlighted and caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. do not change.

Five frames 35.0 to 35.8 s. The first three continue the car through standing water with spray, tree and pole at right. At 35.6 s the picture cuts to the stamped recall card on the wooden desk, now larger with a blank lower area. Label returns to Illustration. Generic car with no brand mark. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. appears at 35.8 s.

Five frames 36.0 to 36.8 s. A new Remedy panel in the lower part of the recall card is revealed and fills with peach, reading The remedy is currently under development. A hand holding a pen enters from the right edge in the last two frames. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. holds.

Five frames 37.0 to 37.8 s. A forearm with a pen tip rests pointing at the text The remedy is currently under development. on the peach Remedy panel. In the last frame the card is slightly bigger and a second forearm holding a wooden stamp block comes in from the lower right. Caption holds unchanged.

Five frames 38.0 to 38.8 s. Two forearms in blue sleeves hold a pen and a wooden stamp block over the lower part of the recall card. The block shifts slightly and presses at the end, a partly hidden orange stamp beginning with Und appears beneath it at 38.8 s. Caption holds unchanged.

Five frames 39.0 to 39.8 s. The recall card now carries two orange stamps, Software recall and Under development. The stamp arm and pen arm slide out to the right, leaving the card alone by 39.8 s. The caption shows in the first two frames and is gone from 39.4 s.

Five frames 40.0 to 40.8 s. A new scene with four white cars with roof sensors parked in a diagonal row on a wet dark lot with reflections, chain-link fence, trees and a power line behind, a small Vehicle maps card and an April calendar page at right. A Weather limits tightened note card slides in from the left. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, appears from 40.4 s.

Five frames 41.0 to 41.8 s. The parked-car lot scene stays still while the Weather limits tightened card with a rain cloud icon, hanging by a red pin from the wire, slides slowly rightward toward the Vehicle maps card. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, holds.

Five frames 42.0 to 42.8 s. A static hold on the parked-car lot. Only the Weather limits tightened card moves, tilting and swaying slightly under its red pin. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, holds throughout.

Five frames 43.0 to 43.8 s. Three frames hold the same parked-car lot with the Weather limits tightened card. At 43.6 s the camera changes to a lower, closer angle on the row of white cars, front car large at left, others receding right, with a skyline now visible and the cards enlarged. Caption becomes and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

Five frames 44.0 to 44.8 s. Round badges above the white cars in the receding row turn into check marks one after another from the front car to the farthest, by 44.8 s four checks are visible. The Weather limits tightened and Vehicle maps cards and April calendar stay put. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. holds.

Five frames 45.0 to 45.8 s. All four visible cars in the row show check badges. The Vehicle maps card gains a small updated label and an empty circle that turns into a check from 45.2 s. Nothing else moves. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. holds.

Five frames 46.0 to 46.8 s. The April calendar page at right peels so that a large numeral 20 appears under the April header from 46.4 s, and the page above it drops down alongside. The cars, check badges and cards stay still. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. holds.

Five frames 47.0 to 47.8 s. The first four frames hold the parked cars with check badges and the April 20 calendar, with the caption visible only in the first. At 47.8 s the picture cuts to the airport curb with a smaller white car in the pickup bay, a phone card reading Arriving At the curb, an airport sign, bench and skyline. The label reads Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. No caption shown.

Five frames 48.0 to 48.8 s. The airport curb scene returns with the white car parked in the bay, no person visible. The pin on the phone settles on the destination and the car's rear door opens a crack, showing a dark interior, in the last two frames. Caption So the airport ride is open,

Five frames 49.0 to 49.8 s. The white car sits in the pickup bay with its rear door standing open, a tan interior visible, nobody getting in or out. The phone still reads Arriving At the curb. Caption So the airport ride is open, holds for four frames and is gone in the last frame. Nearly static.

Five frames 50.0 to 50.8 s. A wider, lower framing of the airport curb with the white car, rear door open, sign, bench with a small phone on it and a teal suitcase. A small Federal recall record card reading Remedy The remedy is currently under development with an Under development stamp lies in the road in the foreground and rocks a little by 50.8 s. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy appears from 50.2 s.

Five frames 51.0 to 51.8 s. The Federal recall record card with the peach Remedy panel and Under development stamp, lying on the road in front of the open-door car, grows steadily larger and shifts left and downward across the frames. The airport background hardly changes. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy holds.

Five frames 52.0 to 52.8 s. Essentially a held shot of the airport curb with the large recall record card on the road. Only small drifts of the camera. At 52.8 s the caption changes from and the federal record lists the flood remedy to as currently under development.

Five frames 53.0 to 53.8 s. The picture is split into two. At top the airport curb with the white car, rear door open, sign and bench. At bottom a wooden desk holds the recall card, with a black underline progressively drawn beneath under development, and a small phone with a route map reading Arriving. Caption as currently under development. holds.

Five frames 54.0 to 54.8 s. The same split view holds still: white car with open rear door at the curb above, recall card with the underlined under development line and the small phone on the desk below. Caption as currently under development. appears only in the first frame, then no caption. Very little movement.

Five frames 55.0 to 55.8 s of an unchanged split composition. White car with its rear door open at the curb in the upper half, the recall card with the underlined remedy line and a small phone showing Arriving on the desk in the lower half. No caption appears. The lower third of the frame is empty brown desk.

Five frames 56.0 to 56.8 s. A dark navy end card with an orange The Daily Dispatch header, a Texas flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, a texasaidocket.com link line, and small credit blocks for sources, illustration, map and music. The first frame is dimmer and fades up by 56.2 s. No captions. The lower third of the card is empty.

Five identical frames 57.0 to 57.8 s of the dark end card with Texas flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com link and the sources, illustration, map and music credits. No motion and no captions.
Five identical frames 58.0 to 58.8 s showing the same dark end card with the flag icon, wordmark, link and credit blocks. No motion and no captions.
Five identical frames 59.0 to 59.8 s of the same dark end card with flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, link, and credit blocks. No motion and no captions.
Five identical frames 60.0 to 60.8 s of the same dark end card with flag icon, wordmark, link and credit blocks. No motion and no captions.

One frame at 60.967 s, frame 1829. The dark end card with The Daily Dispatch header, Texas flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com link and credit blocks, identical to the preceding end card frames. No caption.
